questions.question: To make Isaac's favorite dish, what did Rebekah send her son Jacob to get from the flock?
When his blind father Isaac asked which son he was, what did Jacob say?

answers.text: I am Jacob your younger son
I am a servant sent by Esau

questions.question: When Esau asked his father Isaac for the blessing, what did Isaac say had happened to it?

answers.text: Your brother came deceitfully and took it
A stranger tricked me at the door
Your servant brought me the dish first

questions.question: After Jacob received his father's blessing, where did Isaac say Esau's home would be?

answers.text: Away from the richness of the land
In the well-watered plain of the Jordan
In a land flowing with milk and honey
